title: 第14章 我看到有个黑影闪过去了！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    粘稠的恐惧感如同实质般的蛛网，慢慢缠绕上许默二人的心脏，根本无法靠意志力去强行压制。

    回程的路上，安静得令人发指。

    没有虫鸣，没有风声，只有两人急促的呼吸和踩碎枯叶的沙沙声。

    窸窣——！

    一团灰色的影子毫无征兆地从方芸脚边的灌木丛里炸起，直扑她的面门。

    方芸的眼神冷厉，没有任何惊呼，手腕一翻，一支削尖的木箭被她当做短匕，极为刁钻的角度狠狠掼下。

    噗嗤一声闷响。

    那只有攻击性的灰兔被死死钉在泥地里，四肢剧烈抽搐了几下，彻底没了声息。

    白捡一顿肉食，可两人的脸上却看不到半分喜色。

    方芸猛地拔出木箭，带起一蓬血水，指尖颤抖着指向左前方的浓密阴影。

    “那边！我看到有个黑影闪过去了！”

    许默骤然转头，眼角的余光恰好捕捉到一抹极其深邃、连光线都能吞噬的诡异轮廓，如游蛇般悄无声息地没入了一棵三人环抱的古树背后。

    【洞察之眼】，开！

    眼底幽蓝色的数据流反射光彩。

    然而许默的动作猛地一滞。

    没有数据！没有生命体征！甚至连一丁点活动的痕迹都没有！

    那个黑影，就像是凭空蒸发了，又或者……它根本就不属于常理认知范畴。

    “跑！”

    两人再也顾不上掩盖行踪，几乎是甩开步子在昏暗的丛林中发足狂奔。

    身后的黑暗就贴着他们的后背。

    终于，熟悉的山洞透过稀疏的林叶跃入眼帘。

    庇护所！

    方芸一个箭步冲上前，单手扣住门板猛地一拽。

    两人一前一后撞进石屋，许默反手将门砰地一声砸上，沉重的门栓瞬间落下。

    后背贴在冰冷坚硬的石壁上，许默大口大口地喘着粗气。

    一门之隔，那股如附骨之疽般的惊悚感，竟快速减弱，但并未消失。

    许默立刻唤出状态栏。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The thick fear was like a substantial spider web, slowly wrapping around the hearts of Xu Mo and the two of them, unable to be suppressed by willpower.

On the way back, it was eerily quiet.

There was no sound of insects, no sound of wind, only the rapid breathing of the two people and the rustle of crushed dead leaves.

Rustling——!

A group of gray shadows exploded from the bushes at Fang Yun’s feet without any warning, heading straight towards her face.

Fang Yun's eyes were cold and stern, without any exclamation. She flipped her wrist and used a sharpened wooden arrow as a dagger, and struck it down at an extremely tricky angle.

There was a muffled sound.

The aggressive gray rabbit was nailed to the mud, its limbs twitched violently several times, and it made no sound at all.

It was a free meal of meat, but there was no hint of joy on their faces.

Fang Yun suddenly pulled out the wooden arrow, bringing up a pool of blood. Her fingertips trembled and pointed at the dense shadow in front of her left.

"Over there! I saw a black shadow flash past!"

Xu Mo suddenly turned his head, and out of the corner of his eye, he happened to catch a strange outline that was so deep that even light could be swallowed up. It sank silently like a snake behind an ancient tree surrounded by three people.

【Eye of Insight】, open!

The blue data flow under the eyes reflects the light.

However, Xu Mo's movements suddenly stopped.

No data!No vital signs!Not even the slightest trace of activity!

That black shadow seemed to have evaporated out of thin air, or... it simply did not fall into the realm of common sense.

"Run!"

The two of them no longer cared about covering their whereabouts, and almost ran away in the dark jungle.

The darkness behind them pressed against their backs.

Finally, the familiar cave came into view through the sparse forest leaves.

Shelter!

Fang Yun rushed forward, grabbed the door panel with one hand and pulled hard.

The two of them ran into the stone house one after another. Xu Mo slammed the door with his backhand, and the heavy door bolt fell instantly.

With his back pressed against the cold and hard stone wall, Xu Mo gasped for air.

Separated by the door, the thrilling feeling like gangrene in the bones weakened rapidly, but it did not disappear.

Xu Mo immediately called up the status bar.
